title: GitHub-Telegram Notification Bot
description: Built a CI/CD-linked notification utility that automatically dispatches real-time alerts to a specific Telegram chat whenever GitHub push or pull request events are triggered.
highlights: Configured automated YAML workflows to listen to repository webhooks.
Secured environment variables and API tokens using GitHub Secrets.

title: E-Commerce & Library Management DB Design
description: Designed and mapped comprehensive relational database schemas for complex management systems, focusing on data integrity and performance.
highlights: Successfully normalized complex architectures up to 3NF and BCNF to eliminate data redundancy.
Transcribed visual entity-relationship diagrams into clean DBML scripts for documentation.

title: Modular Full-Stack Backend Integration
description: Developed a modular, feature-based backend application utilizing modern architectural patterns and robust ORM mapping.
highlights: Structured a highly clean, feature-driven directory path using NestJS modules, pipes, and custom decorators.
Integrated Prisma ORM with a local MySQL instance ('RDTC') to handle smooth schema migrations and type-safe database queries.
